figurative_meaning_en: Inside information, confidential or secret matters
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ব্যাপারের হাঁড়ির খবর কেউ জানে না।
example_sentences_in_english: No one knows the confidential details of this matter.
note: Originates from the imagery of a cooking pot in traditional Bengali households, symbolizing hidden family matters.
